verbatim_common_definitions_and_executio.definitions: Common definitions: closed epoch-UTC 1m bars form 1h and 4h bars; missing minutes invalidate bars. ATR20 is the arithmetic mean of 20 hourly true ranges using prior closes. EMA20/EMA50 on 4h closes use SMA seeds then alpha 2/(N+1); require at least 60 completed 4h bars. ER12 is absolute 12-bar close displacement divided by sum of absolute consecutive displacements, with zero denominator ineligible. Direction sign d is +1 LONG, -1 SHORT. Thresholds below are design constants, not fitted to R2 returns; approval may amend them only before the later outcome campaign freeze.
verbatim_common_definitions_and_executio.execution: For both families: hourly decision at exclusive hour end+60s assumed availability; earliest fill at following minute open (hour end+120s). At decision ATR20/close must be 30–250bps. At fill, signed gap from decision close >0.25 ATR20 or an invalid stop vetoes entry; adverse and favorable gaps use the same absolute-gap veto. Risk distance at actual modeled entry must be 30–250bps. Fixed stop is not moved to pass economics. Target is entry+d×2×initial risk distance; maximum hold is exactly 4h or12h from fill. Stop/target/time exit, no trailing, partial TP, averaging down or new position within an open same-symbol position. If a1m bar touches both stop and target, SL resolves first. An open beyond the adverse stop executes at that worse open; an ordinary stop executes at stop, then adverse friction. Target executes at its fixed price even if the open gaps favorably beyond it, with taker friction and no gap overcredit. Time exit uses the first minute open at/after entry+maxhold; stop at that open takes precedence. All exits use adverse tick rounding and friction exactly once; no same-bar hindsight fill. After exit, four-hour cooldown; structural family additionally needs a newer completed 4h bar than its preceding entry. Retest event identity is symbol/direction/breakout-hour; at most one entry per event per variant, even after cooldown. Gap-veto/no-fill never retries the event. Every WAIT/veto/overlap is retained.
